translations.web: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.
translations.bsb: Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
translations.kjv: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
translations.asv: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
